tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// thugs rje chen po'i mig 'byed mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi gter byon gsal byed dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// thugs rje chen po'i spyan 'byed kyi lo rgyus ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyang ston sgrub pos lho brag mkhar chu'i gter nas bton/ des kho rang gi spyan gsal bar byas/ de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen deng ma ba'i spyan nyang stod du gsal bar byas pas zab par shes so// ser sna ma byed rgya cher spel gsungs so// 'di'i sgom thabs dngos gzhi ni/ rang thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis sngags chu spyan la byug pa'i phyag rgya byas pa can/ g.yas 'og mas dngul dkar gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ g.yon 'og mas me long bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bsgom/ sngags 'di mi tshig gis bar ma chod par stong bzlas/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi srin lag gi rtsa bar sngags 'di nyi shu rtsa gcig zas ma zos pa'i gong du btab la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i srin lag gis sngags chu mig g.yon la byug de bzhin du g.yon pas g.yas la byug sngags ni 'di'o// tad+ya thā/ ā+oṃ hu ya hu ya/ hu du hu du/ ki li ki li/ tsak+ṣuḥmai tri sha trū na ye swā hā/ zab rgya rgya/ 'di'i sku sgom tshul la bzhengs pa dang bzhugs pa gnyis 'dug pa brtag par rigs shing*/ yang na sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi dus yin nam brtag go /bla ma mchog la gus pas 'dud// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la sogs lan gsum bya/ de nas stong par sbyang*/ de'i ngang las pad zla'i steng yi ge hrīḥdakar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis mig 'byed sngags chus mig la byug pa'i phyag rgya bcas pa/

g.yas 'og mas dngul dkar gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang*/ g.yon 'og mas dngul dkar gyi me long rab 'byams zhing khams gsal bar sku khrus gsol ba/ zhabs gnyis 'gro ba'i don la mngon par bzhengs pa'i sku la rin po che la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ dar dkar gyi stod g.yogs dang*/ pañca li kā'i sham thabs can/ ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ rigs kyi bdag po snang ba mtha' yas kyi rigs bdag dang bcas pa'i thugs kar sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las/ 'od zer dang sngags kyi nus pa phyag rgya'i rtse las 'phros pas/ rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad la sogs pa phyi nang bar 'grib/ sngo 'grib/ rtsa khra/ sha 'dzer/ ling thog skam rlon 'tshags pa/ pags chang*/ 'dzer lhog la sogs pa'i skyon/ mig nad thams cad sel ba'i nus stobs dang ldan par bsam/ de nas sngags bzla ba ni/ tad+ya thā/ ā+oṃ hu ya hu ya/ hu du hu du/ ki li ki li/ tsak+ṣuḥmai tri sha trū na ye swā hā/ zhes stong phrag brgya/ nyer gcig rab 'bring tha/ g.yas g.yon go bzlog gis gang mi gsal ba sngon du 'byed tshul bya/ thu gsum/ hu gsum/ phu gsum re btab rdzas mig phug nas phyir 'ded tshul gyis dbye ba lags/ de nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang sogs dang*/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs brjod/ 'di yan dpe tshan dang po gter byon dngos de yin pa 'dra/ 'di la'ang rgyas bsdus gnyis 'dug go ang*/ 'og ma 'di zhal shes lag len yin pa 'dra// ༈ /thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas mig 'byed kyi gdams pa nyang gi gter ma de nyid kyi skabs don gsum gsal byed bzhugs so// gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ thugs rje chen pos rtag par 'gro kun la// gzigs mdzad yi dam lha la gus btud nas// de yi sgo nas mthong byed chu bur mig /rgyal ba'i spyan ltar gsal bar byed pa'i thabs// sngags la brten pa'i man ngag zab mo 'di// dang po gang las byung ba'i lo rgyus ni// dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyang ston sgrub pa po// zhes pa mnga' bdag chen po nyang ral pa// mtshan dngos nyi ma 'od zer grags pa des// gnas ni lho brag mkhar chu'i gter nas bton// de ni khong rang dag gis nyams su bzhes// spyan nas 'byung 'gyur ma lus gsal bar byas// de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen deng ma ba'i// spyan gnyis 'grib par gyur la nyang stod du// gdams pa bka' gtad bskur nas gsal bar byas// bsnyen pa sngags 'byed byin rlabs che bar grags// zab par shes so ser sna ma byed par// gdul bya rnams la rgya cher spel zhes gsungs// de lta'i gdams pa shog dril nyang chen sras// 'gro ba'i mgon pos smra bo lcogs po ru// ri bskor mdzad tshe gter shog phyag tu babs// nyams bzhes spyan gnyis gsal bar sku tshe bsgril// de lta ba nyid ji bzhin gter shog bu// drang so sngags 'chang shākya bzang po yis// lho brag gnas chen gtam shul ri bo la// bskor ba'i lam khar rlung gis khyer pa ltar// gdams pa'i yi ge 'khrul med sku mdun rnyed// gong gi gdams pa sgo gnyis rim brgyud du// gsan par ma ltos khyad par bka' babs bzhed// sku tshe mthar phyin nyid du spyan yang gsal// de la zab gter gsum ka'i bka' babs rje// mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po legs ldan zhabs// sku tshe brgya phrag nyid du 'gro ba'i don// lhur mdzad nyin mtshan chos kyi sbyin par brtson// bgres rgud mi mnga' ye shes spyan can des// dges bzhin bdag la gnang ba da lta'i bar// rgya dbus ljang gtsang kun tu 'gro don byas// de ni rang yang nyams su len bde zhing*// rjes 'jug yongs la phan phyir rgyas par bkrol// dang po yig rnying ma nyams rtsa bar byas// gnyis pa 'di yi sgom thabs dngos gzhi ni// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/de skad skyabs sems sdom phyir lan gsum bya// swa bhā wa yi sngags kyis snod bcud sbyangs// stong pa'i ngang las rang rig hrīḥdakar po// skad cig yongs gyur thugs rje chen po nyid// shel gyi ri bo ltar gsal rnam dag sku// zhal gcig zla rgyas zhi 'dzum phyag bzhi pa// dri med pad+ma dang ni zla ba'i dkyil// gdan la zhabs zung mnyam pa'i stabs bzhengs pa// phyag bzhi dang po gnyis kyis mig 'byed kyi// sngags chu spyan la byug pa'i phyag rgya can// thugs kar bcas shing g.yas kyi 'og ma yi// dngul gyi bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba// bsnams pas sdig sgrib dri ma kun 'khrud pa// g.yon gyi 'og mas me long bsnams pa la// rab 'byams zhing khams gsal bar sku khrus gsol// sna tshogs rin po che yi rgyan gyis brgyan// dar gyi sham thabs na bzas nyer bklubs te// ri dwags lpags pas nu ma g.yon la bkab// gsung mchog snang ba mtha' yas dbu la brgyan// dam tshig ye shes dbyer med nyid du gyur// sngon 'gro dge ba'i las 'bad yar ngo la// dben par mtshams gcod grib 'dzem dkar gsum bsten// tho rangs nas brtsam sngags 'di mi tshig gis// bar ma chod pa stong bzlas dmigs pa ni// sngags nus phyag rgya'i rtse las 'od zer 'phros// g.yas 'og bum pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis// g.yon pa'i me long ngos su khrus gsol ba'i// byed pa ji bzhin rang gzhan mkha' mnyam pa'i// sems can kun gyi bag chags las sdig sgrib// nad gdon grib las gyur pa'i sgrib byed kun// rlung gis sprin gtor dri ma 'khrud pa ltar// rnam gsal dag dran brtan byas bsnyen sgrub ste// lag pa g.yas dang g.yon pa'i srin lag gi /rtsa bar sngags 'di nyi shu rtsa gcig re// zas ma zos pa'i gong la bzlas byas pa// g.yas pa'i srin lag dag gi rtse mo yis// g.yon pa'i sngags chu mnye zhing rtse mo brdar// mig g.yon phug nas phyir la byug cing phyis// de bzhin g.yon pas g.yas la byug cing phyis// rab rib grib sogs nad gdon kun phyis nas// mig gnyis rnam dag spyan sgo phyes par bsam// phyogs la gsal 'grib khyad par yod pa na// 'grib phyogs sngags btab phye tshul sngon la bya// de ltar las sbyor rgyun du 'bad byas te// sngags ni 'di ltar gces pa'i yig 'bru'i them// tad+ya thā ā+oṃ hu ya hu ya brgyad/

hu du hu du ki li ki li brgyad/ tsak+ṣuḥmai tri sha trū na ye brgyad/ brgyad tshan gsum mthar swā hā dang bcas pa'i// brgyad tshan dang po'i gsum dang bzhi pa dang*// de bzhin gsum pa'i drug pa mthar swā hā// yig 'bru lnga la 'a btags gzhan thung du// nyi shu rtsa drug 'khrul med zab mo 'di// tho rangs zas gzhan gong ste nyin dang mtshan// rang rang rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dkyus la 'jug /ched du bsngags pa'i bsgrub bya dag yin na// skabs der yang ni ma ṇi'i 'dzab bsgoms la// gtsor bton bya'o zab phyir bsnyen bsgrub ni// dus kyi bsnyen pa zhag bdun nyi shu gcig /grangs bsnyen gong du nyams len skabs bshad bzhin// mtshan ma'i nges pa nyi shar sgron me sbar// sgo phye g.yogs bsal mig ldan sbyin mthong thos// rab yin khrus byas gyen 'dzegs mthong yangs bgrod// dri can mdog nag zhwa gos l+h+wam phud 'bring*// mun khungs 'dam rdzab kha char bu yug byings// grib sel sgrib sbyor rim gro spang dag 'bad// phan stobs dge dang mi dge'i brda' dang rtags// mtshan ma dngos nyams rmi lam nges par 'byung*// gang shar rten 'brel legs pa'i babs su bsgyur// gsum pa 'di la 'bad dgos phan yon ni// dbang po'i dngas ma mig las gces pa gzhan// ci zhig de phyir nad med gzhon nu nas// bsnyen sgrub sngon song mig skyon 'byung mi 'gyur// pha ma la sogs 'grib rigs sri las thar// mig nas 'gos pa'i rigs dang 'tshe ba skyob// phyi nang bar 'grib ling thog rtsa khrag srin// tshags pa skam rlon rdzi ma'i nad gang la'ang*// sman rdzas dpyad dang mtshungs pa'i phan pa ster// rtsa shed skye zhing gsal snang nyams su myong*// gsod dpyad gzhung las spang bya'i gnas bshad pa// dbye dus ma slebs yol sogs 'ga' zhig la'ang*// gdams pa 'di yi zab khyad ston par byed// de phyir gnas skabs chu bur mig gsal bas// chos nyid mngon sum ngo mtshar ltad mo lta// mthar thug ye shes spyan ldan thob phyir du// lo rgyus nyams len phan yon don gsum du// gsal bar bsdebs 'di sngags 'chang rig pa 'dzin// shrī bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes// bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi lon tshe ljongs kyi yul// pad+ma'i lcog sgar gnas su sbyar ba 'dis// ji snyed 'gro la phan don byed gyur cig

/sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'di'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni// snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje chen po dang*// pad+ma 'byung gnas nyang chen sgrub pa por// gsol ba 'debs so gsal byed dngos grub stsol// 'gro ba'i mgon po shākya bzang po dang*// rig 'dzin legs ldan chos rgyal dbang po'i sde// gsol ba 'debs so gsal byed dngos grub stsol// 'di yan chos rgyal dbang po'i sdes gsungs so// de'i kha skong du/ rigs kun khyab bdag ngag gi dbang po dang*// mkhas btsun grub brnyes bkra shis rnam rgyal mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so gsal byed dngos grub stsol// rdo rje 'chang dngos dkon mchog dpal 'byor zhabs// rig 'dzin grub pa'i gtsug rgyan pad+ma'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so gsal byed dngos grub stsol// bstan pa'i gsal byed blo bzang don grub zhabs// gdams pa'i bka' babs rtsa pa'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so gsal byed dngos grub stsol// ces pa'ang bdag rig pa 'dzin pa bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis/ mig la phan pa'i gdams pa 'di'i bsnyen mtshams zhag bdun byas te grol ba'i dga' ston du gdams pa'i dpe 'di lcags 'brug rang lo nga gsum pa hor zla bdun pa'i nyer lnga la grub pa'i bsti gnas o rgyan gling du bris pa'i dge bas mar gyur sems can thams cad ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa thob par gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/ brgyud pa'i kha skong ni/ blo bzang don grub rjes su/ thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' lhun grub la// gsol ba 'debs so gsal byed dngos grub stsol// 'jig rten dbang phyug khyab bdag gnas gsar pa// zab gsang bstan pa'i nyi ma kun blo'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so gsal byed dngos grub stsol// mkhas shing grub brnyes nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// gdams pa'i bka' babs rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so gsal byed dngos grub stsol/ zhes pa'ang bya bral ba mañju gho ṣas e waṃ mok+ṣā grar bris pa shu bhaṃ//

// ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
